changelog: Fix: Universes-Within flavor names (Dracula reprints from Innistrad Crimson Vow, Warhammer 40K, Doctor Who, etc.) now resolve correctly when you paste a Moxfield Export -> Text decklist
New: three-pass deck resolver — canonical cards.name, then local card_aliases cache, then a one-time Scryfall fuzzy fallback that caches forever so the same deck re-imports offline next time
Also in: friendlier error message when Moxfield URL import is blocked by Cloudflare (v0.1.4); paste-the-text workaround documented in the product-page FAQ
371 tests green (+6 new covering the three-pass resolver and offline-graceful-degradation)
